assumptions: For the conditional ratio identity: fixed lesion class; pair-specific post-division split p:(1-p); constant sister-specific first-order repair over the short window; positive shared physical-assay gain; measured/subtracted common additive background; no new differential lesion production; known cytokinesis time and retained sister identity. These assumptions are not established for 53BP1 or γH2AX.
contract.interface: Input: sister-pair physical lesion measurements at at least two known post-division times, calibration/background, cell-cycle covariates, fate and observation status. Output: under the stated model, partition log-odds is ratio intercept and differential repair is slope; otherwise UNKNOWN.

candidate.representation: Conditional log sister physical-damage ratio: log(P1/P2)=logit(p)+(k2-k1)t; focus measurement adds unknown sister reporter-loading ratio.
candidate.hypothesis: The focal ESC paper establishes paired damage-response-marker asymmetry, but the available public material does not establish lesion-class-specific physical burden at cytokinesis linked to both daughter fates.
candidate.verdict: REJECT_AS_NEW_ADVANCE; the algebra is elementary and the general mechanism is preempted. Remaining physical-lesion-at-boundary question is UNKNOWN.

missing_lemma: No novel theorem remains. The scientific blocker is an acquired measurement of a named physical lesion class at the division boundary in spontaneous MERVL/Zscan4-positive ESC daughters, with sister-fate linkage and observation-process accounting.
comparator: Matched MERVL-negative divisions and same-information restricted models: equal partition/equal repair; partition-only; repair-only; joint; reporter-only. Hold out one time or orthogonal measurement. Include all fates, deaths, and tracking losses.
falsifier_or_next_experiment: If calibrated physical burden is symmetric at the earliest resolution while only DDR-reporter asymmetry emerges later, or a repair/formation model predicts the late asymmetry without a physical partition, the partition interpretation fails. Next gate is raw sister-resolved data or a calibrated physical-lesion assay at/near cytokinesis linked to both outcomes.
unresolved_or_UNKNOWN: whether 2C-like ESC damage-associated asymmetry is physical lesion segregation at the division boundary

physical lesion vs postmitotic lesion formation/repair/signaling contributions
whether physical lesion burden independently predicts branch fate after cell-cycle and selection adjustment
novelty of the narrow future experiment after broader priority search
